answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the voyage of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the pearl is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
